journey.name: Continue a focus session in the background
journey.description: With fresh app data, verify that a running focus session continues when the app is minimized, and that the persistent notification offers working pause and resume controls.

actions.action: Verify that the timer shows '25:00'
Tap 'Iniciar'
If the 'Receber avisos de sessão' dialog appears, tap 'Permitir'
If Android asks for notification permission, allow notifications
Wait 3 seconds
Remember the remaining time shown by the timer
Press the device Home button
Wait 10 seconds
Return to PomoLume using the device recent apps screen
Verify that 'Sessão de foco' and the 'Pausar' button are visible
Verify that the remaining time is at least 10 seconds lower than the previously remembered time
Open the device notification shade
Verify that the ongoing session notification is visible
Tap 'Pausar' in the ongoing session notification
Return to PomoLume using the device recent apps screen
Verify that the 'Continuar' button is visible
Remember the remaining time shown by the timer
Press the device Home button
Wait 5 seconds
Return to PomoLume using the device recent apps screen
Verify that the remaining time has not changed while paused
Tap 'Continuar'
Verify that the 'Pausar' button is visible
